extracted.name: Famous Peanut Butter Bread
extracted.description: Since everyone’s home during these trying times I came across some recipes to try.
instruction_lines: Mix in milk then add peanut butter
Pour mixture in greased loaf pan
Bake about an hour. You can also add chocolate chips and vanilla extract as I did but it’s based on what you like. Some people used Nutella instead of peanut butter.
